name: Laguna Cerro Castillo
why: The Torres del Paine of the Carretera Austral: basalt spires and a hanging glacier over a green lake, with a fraction of the people.
book: CONAF entry fee, plus a private-land fee at the start. Register at the ranger post.
water: Streams in the forest; nothing above it.
dangers: The last 400 m climb is steep scree.
Snow and closed trail until December.
